purpose: Numbers printed in the platform research report that are NOT measurements from the metrics artifact: stated bounds, gate thresholds, and observations that the snapshot does not carry. Each entry must name the exact wording it is allowed to back, so that a fabricated number can never borrow an alibi. Declared claims are counted separately by tools/chronicle/validate_report.py and are never reported as metric-validated.

constants.reason: stated upper bound used in the prose argument (no single repository exceeds this share); a bound, not a measurement
six-element report gate error threshold, quoted as a criterion definition
worker claim-token active span; the metrics snapshot carries only total_workers, so this span is an observation outside the snapshot and stays flagged as declared
size of the aggregate group discussed in §4.2 (a selection, not a measured count)
